nom: medicube Azelaic Acid Niacinamide Deep Clean Whip Cleanser

avis.texte: OMG!! I have struggled with an oily/ combination skin all my life. By the end of the day, my face would be slick and greasy. I saw results after the first use. I had terrible blackheads and cystic acne. Because of my oily skin, I had larger pores also.My personal experience, it's worth the money. It has reduced the appearance of my pores, hardly any blackheads, less oily skin, improved texture. It has only been 3 days using morning and night. My face did kind of dry out just a little but nothing extreme. I only use a tiny amount and this stuff just foams up and grows. Directions are easy to follow. Use sparingly. My face feels smoother, evening out skin tone. I mean, Wow. I'm impressed. I did break out a little bit the first couple of days but that's just the product lifting all the dirt out I'm sure. Medium strength my skin isn't very sensitive though. I'm not getting paid for this review btw. Just very satisfied. 10/10 would recommend.

I jumped on the medicube bandwagon due to it's popularity and I have NO regrets. I'm 39 with combination/oily skin, large pores, sensitive acne prone skin that has the temperament of a teenager. After reading thousands of reviews I thought why not 🤷🏼‍♀️. This is very thick and sticky and comes out like a mud mask because you can use it as a cleanser or mask. For a cleanser you only need like a dime size or less amount, add water to make a later then put it on your face. I use a massage brush with it and OMG. My skin literally felt like glass, wet and dry and it didn't over dry my skin. My skin felt clean and comfortable, no tightness . My pores were tighter with just one use and the black dots on my nose were way lighter, I had to get really close to even see them. Only thing I didn't like was the smell. To me, it's a fishy turpentine/paint thinner. Good thing is it only last a few minutes after you rinse. If you can get thru the smell this face wash is a must! I think if you use it just add a cleanser, since it takes very little, it'll last a while so it's very affordable for the quality and the packaging is eye catching and chic.

avis.texte: I’ve been using the MediCube Azelaic Acid Whip Cream Cleanser for about 1–2 months now, and I genuinely think this product is a miracle for my skin. I used to struggle with constant pimples, clogged pores, oily skin, uneven texture, and random breakouts almost every day. I first used the MediCube Zero Pore SA Capsule Cleanser to help get my acne under control, and now this Azelaic Acid cleanser has become my perfect maintenance cleanser because it’s much gentler while still being super effective. This cleanser makes my skin feel so smooth, clear, fresh, and balanced. My face no longer gets extremely oily just a few hours after washing. Instead, my skin feels hydrated with the perfect oil and moisture balance — not greasy, not dry, just healthy and soft. What I LOVE most is how gentle it is. Unlike stronger acne cleansers, this one doesn’t make my skin itchy, irritated, or overly dry. It even gives a nice cooling effect after washing, which feels amazing. The texture improvement has been incredible too. My skin is now so smooth that I’m starting to focus more on fading freckles and dark spots because my texture is finally clear enough for them to stand out more! I also use the MediCube Azelaic Acid Serum right after washing my face, and together they work amazingly well. Azelaic acid from MediCube has honestly been a total game changer for me. avis.titre: Great Azelaic Acid Cleanser That Calms Skin Without Drying It OutGreat Azelaic Acid Cleanser That Calms Skin Without Dry
avis.texte: At 52, post-menopausal, with dry and increasingly sensitive skin, I’m very careful with cleansers — especially ones that include active ingredients like azelaic acid. It’s very easy for treatment-focused cleansers to tip my skin into dryness or irritation, so I tend to look for formulas that support the skin rather than push it too hard. This one strikes that balance really well. I also use quite a few Medicube products, including the Medicube Age-R Pro device, so I was especially interested in trying this cleanser. I’ve had consistently good experiences with the brand, and this fits right in with the rest of what I’ve tried — gentle, thoughtful, and easy to use daily. Even though this contains azelaic acid, this is a very gentle cleanser. The foam is soft and cushiony, and it cleans thoroughly without leaving my skin tight or dry. My skin feels comfortable after rinsing, which is something I always pay attention to, especially when using a cleanser with actives. Over time, what I notice most is that my skin looks calmer and more balanced. This isn’t an overnight results type of product — and I actually prefer that in a cleanser. Instead, it’s the kind of cleanser that supports your skin day after day. My skin looks more even, and I’ve noticed less redness, especially when my skin is feeling more reactive. avis.titre: Makes my face feel squeaky clean
avis.texte: I loved this cleanser. It makes my face feel squeaky clean after using it, which I really like, but it does not feel heavy or leave any residue behind. It lathers nicely, rinses off easily, and leaves my skin feeling fresh. I also like that it has azelaic acid, which is a nice bonus for uneven skin texture, redness, and breakouts. Pleasant and subtle fragrance. Overall, this is a great facial cleanser and I would definitely buy it again.

avis.titre: Acne girlies looking for smoother skin, this is for you!
avis.texte: For starters, I have very sensitive acne prone skin. I have purchased this cleanser at least three times and whenever I stray, I pay the price. I love this stuff. It does exactly what it claims to do; controls excess sebum, soothes redness, and improves uneven skin tone. The cleanser turns into a rich foam as you wash. It is not heavily scented, which I appreciate. 10/10. Will continue to repurchase.

I love this cleanser! I've started collecting the Medicube products for my daily skin care. I will be buying this again when I'm out. It has a smooth texture and a decent light smell. It has helped with my large pores and oily skin. Great value for the type of product.

avis.titre: A little goes a very long way
avis.texte: The consistency is quite thick and less than a pea size amount is enough at a time. The consistency becomes into a rich thick foam and stringy, similar to few other Korean products, once you mix it in your palms with water. It is non-irritating on the skin and I haven’t seen any benefits after 1 month of use. But it does a good job as a cleanser.

avis.texte: I Absolutely love how this cleanser gives you a deep clean without destroying your skin barrier! I don’t know why but I love the smell of it too lol. Perfect for oily sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Perfecto para piel grasa o con imperfecciones
avis.texte: He estado usando este limpiador facial durante varias semanas y mi experiencia ha sido buena, la textura inicial es un poco diferente (como una pasta) y al mezclar con agua hace una espuma cremosa que se siente muy agradable en la piel. Me gusta los ingredientes activos, ayudan a limpiar los poros, controlar el exceso de grasa y suavizar la textura de la piel sin dejarla tirante. No note una mejoría muy rápida en manchas pero si una sensación mas uniforme. Lo recomiendo si quieres un limpiador que limpie sin irritar si en especial tu piel tiende a estar grasa o con imperfecciones puntuales.

He estado usándolo casi 1 mes, me gustó, si necesita añadir un jabón a tu rutina de control de acné leve este es muy bueno, literal con poco producto te lavas toda la cara muy bien. Y también sirve como mascarilla. Me gusta la sensación que deja luego enjuagar.

A little bit goes a very, very, very long way, not even a third of a dime sign size drop can wash your entire face and declitage... i have sensitive skin and I am truly thrilled that this and its other brand products have made my face and neck area hydrated as well as smooth with no residue and my pores are back to normal.
